review_kind: Independent static pre-run review of actual GPU harness
status: Static dynamics and observation design acceptable; execution gate and failure preservation need repair before freeze

findings.finding: execute() does not enforce compiled build_record library/source/header/executable identities against committed preregistration pins. An alternate --backend can compile a different backend even when repository inputs remain committed.
findings.repair: Require matching preregistered backend/library and production-source hashes; compare build record to current harness, driver, generated header and executable before native invocation. Stage checker may implement this but must audit the actual selected build, not a different historical record.

findings.finding: command() uses check=True with capture_output=True. A failed native run raises before execute() writes captured stdout/stderr, losing native failure diagnostics even when an incomplete trace survives.
findings.repair: Run native command with check=False; persist stdout, stderr and exit status first, then stop on nonzero exit. Preserve failures without accepting incomplete traces.

findings.finding: Required stage checker did not exist at review time, so native execution through the driver would fail safely. The future checker must enforce the intended source/implementation/readiness distinctions.

Reference docstring describes only archived CPU semantics, while the primary is actual GPU. Inspected GPU RK4 nine-parameter branch has matching delayed threshold, reset-only iteration, millisecond refractory counter and voltage floor rules.
findings.repair: Describe independently specified matching GPU/CPU clock semantics and preserve actual native float32 parameter, current and initial-state matching. Native float32 timestep and inverse_C rounding versus exact-grid float64 reference are numerical differences to measure, not proof of exact arithmetic equivalence.

accepted_static_checks: Actual GPU_MODE/GPU_CORES used; one target neuron and silent zero-weight auxiliary connection rather than artificial biological replicate population.
Fresh process per current/timestep; only initial target voltage, nextVoltage, recovery, ref_counter and curSpike are written before runNetwork, with float32 roundtrip checks.
Inspected SNN::runNetwork does not reinitialize voltage/recovery after setup. setExternalCurrent copies external current only.
Archived parameter row is verified by file hash and exact row equality; generated float constants and native stdout expose actual float32 parameter/current/state values.

Observer calls real DtoD copy first and only matches target partition nextVoltage-to-voltage pointers and DtoD direction. Scalar real DtoH reads serialize completed GPU state without observation-path writes.
globalStateUpdate_N_GPU launches kernel then DtoD once per substep; simTime increments after advSimStep, so ms+j/substeps labels agree with inspected clock order.

Link map selects snn_gpu_module-cu.o and excludes interface carlsim-cpp.o. Static disassembly of reviewed binary shows globalStateUpdate_N_GPU calling __wrap_cudaMemcpy; wrapper existence alone was not the only evidence.

GPU kernel uses hardcoded manager Izh_ref=1, delayed previous-nextVoltage strict threshold, reset-only iteration, counter decrement only lastIteration, frozen recovery/voltage during refractory, and -90mV floor after smooth update. Reference separately implements these rules through DOP853 spans.
Compile log is empty and record exit code is zero. Build record says no simulation executed; review did not launch the executable.
runtime_unverified: GPU allocation/state roundtrip and actual parameter assertions
Observed trace completeness, clock checks and parse integrity
Holding drift, resets, refractory transitions, event counts/order and boundary ambiguity
Same-grid independently tightened reference agreement and cross-grid event-time/count stability
gate_scope: Native environment/argument guard is an operational safeguard; it does not itself inspect a Git commit. The Python driver and stage verifier must be the authoritative frozen-input check. Compile/static review is not numerical validation or biological validation.
